cases.target_rule: a benchmark target can be an ordinary pure function
cases.intended_cause: The operation has a stable input and consumed output.
cases.principled_repair: Keep setup and result validation outside the timed loop.
cases.weak_repair: Time fixture construction together with the operation.

cases.target_rule: black_box preserves an observed value boundary
cases.intended_cause: The input and output remain observable to the optimizer.
cases.principled_repair: Use black_box at the benchmark boundary while retaining a correctness oracle.
cases.weak_repair: Remove all assertions and trust elapsed time.

cases.target_rule: benchmark workload accounting uses checked arithmetic
cases.intended_cause: The byte count is represented as a fallible calculation.
cases.principled_repair: Reject parameter sets whose accounting overflows.
cases.weak_repair: Use wrapping arithmetic in benchmark metadata.

cases.target_rule: parameterized workloads are typed values
cases.intended_cause: The workload set is explicit and deterministic.
cases.principled_repair: Version and name parameter sets.
cases.weak_repair: Generate an undocumented random size on every run.

cases.target_rule: workload parameters must have the intended type
cases.intended_cause: A string literal cannot initialize a usize parameter.
cases.principled_repair: Parse external configuration and reject invalid values.
cases.weak_repair: Change the parameter to a string and concatenate it in reports.

cases.target_rule: the correctness oracle must compare the actual result type
cases.intended_cause: The measured operation returns u64, not String.
cases.principled_repair: Keep the oracle typed to the product result.
cases.weak_repair: Format every result before measuring.

cases.target_rule: a benchmark smoke path preserves semantic output
cases.intended_cause: The runtime assertion validates the operation.
cases.principled_repair: Run an oracle outside the statistical measurement.
cases.weak_repair: Report a duration without consuming the result.

cases.target_rule: compiling timing code does not make a sound benchmark
cases.intended_cause: The program times allocation and reports one noisy sample.
cases.principled_repair: Separate fixture setup, repeat samples, and name the claim.
cases.weak_repair: Call the single result a stable regression threshold.

cases.target_rule: profiling hypotheses can be supported by typed counters
cases.intended_cause: The counter makes call frequency explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Use counters as focused evidence alongside profiles.
cases.weak_repair: Treat the counter as exact CPU cost.

cases.target_rule: a scaling experiment needs a deterministic oracle
cases.intended_cause: The operation has predictable linear input work.
cases.principled_repair: Vary input size and preserve exact output.
cases.weak_repair: Change input and implementation together.

cases.target_rule: a hot-path iterator can preserve borrowed results
cases.intended_cause: The returned iterator is tied to the input lifetime.
cases.principled_repair: Profile its use in the complete operation.
cases.weak_repair: Allocate a vector only to make profiling easier.

cases.target_rule: cost-model arithmetic should expose overflow
cases.intended_cause: The model is fallible instead of silently wrapping.
cases.principled_repair: Keep model calculations checked.
cases.weak_repair: Use the model as a guaranteed runtime bound.

cases.target_rule: profile counters and aggregates need compatible numeric types
cases.intended_cause: An iterator of &u64 cannot sum into usize.
cases.principled_repair: Choose an explicit common type and checked conversion.
cases.weak_repair: Cast every value with `as`.

cases.target_rule: borrowed profile labels cannot outlive their source
cases.intended_cause: The function promises the result comes from left but returns right.
cases.principled_repair: Tie the output to the actual source or own it.
cases.weak_repair: Leak the label to obtain a static lifetime.

cases.target_rule: an optimized path remains checked against a reference
cases.intended_cause: Both implementations produce the same result.
cases.principled_repair: Retain the oracle for representative and boundary cases.
cases.weak_repair: Delete the oracle after the first favorable profile.

cases.target_rule: inline attributes are accepted without proof of benefit
cases.intended_cause: The compiler cannot determine the product-level trade-off.
cases.principled_repair: Use profile and size evidence before forcing inlining.
cases.weak_repair: Apply inline(always) to every hot-looking function.

cases.target_rule: length and capacity are distinct memory facts
cases.intended_cause: The program observes reserved element capacity.
cases.principled_repair: Report both length and capacity.
cases.weak_repair: Use size_of<Vec<_>>() as total memory.

cases.target_rule: shared ownership can extend retention without copying payload bytes
cases.intended_cause: Arc cloning changes liveness and the strong count.
cases.principled_repair: Track release conditions for shared data.
cases.weak_repair: Call Arc cloning completely free.

cases.target_rule: buffer reuse can be bounded by retained capacity
cases.intended_cause: Oversized buffers can be dropped rather than pooled.
cases.principled_repair: State maximum reusable capacity.
cases.weak_repair: Keep the largest observed allocation forever.

cases.target_rule: memory budgets use checked arithmetic
cases.intended_cause: Overflow becomes an explicit result.
cases.principled_repair: Reject impossible capacity plans.
cases.weak_repair: Use saturating arithmetic and present it as exact.

cases.target_rule: a borrowed view cannot outlive its owner
cases.intended_cause: The String is moved to drop while the view is still used.
cases.principled_repair: Shorten the view lifetime or own the needed field.
cases.weak_repair: Use a raw pointer to bypass the borrow checker.

cases.target_rule: Rc ownership cannot cross a thread boundary
cases.intended_cause: Rc is not Send.
cases.principled_repair: Use Arc when shared cross-thread ownership is required.
cases.weak_repair: Mark a wrapper Send without proving synchronization.

cases.target_rule: clearing a vector does not release its capacity
cases.intended_cause: The runtime assertion exposes retained capacity.
cases.principled_repair: Apply an explicit reuse or shrink policy.
cases.weak_repair: Assume empty means no retained allocation.

cases.target_rule: the compiler cannot reject an unbounded cache
cases.intended_cause: The program is type-correct but has no eviction or memory bound.
cases.principled_repair: Define capacity and release policy.
cases.weak_repair: Rely on process restart as cache management.

cases.target_rule: borrowed byte views preserve checked bounds
cases.intended_cause: Slice::get returns an optional view.
cases.principled_repair: Validate ranges before creating views.
cases.weak_repair: Use unchecked indexing for a cosmetic gain.

cases.target_rule: one deliberate copy can establish an independent lifetime
cases.intended_cause: The String owns the promoted field.
cases.principled_repair: Copy only durable fields after validation.
cases.weak_repair: Borrow into a queue that outlives the frame.

cases.target_rule: chunk boundaries are explicit views rather than payload copies
cases.intended_cause: The iterator yields borrowed slices.
cases.principled_repair: State retention and lifetime.
cases.weak_repair: Call it kernel-level zero copy.

cases.target_rule: copy volume accounting should be checked
cases.intended_cause: The sum cannot silently overflow.
cases.principled_repair: Record byte movement by boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Count only clone calls.

cases.target_rule: a borrowed buffer view cannot be returned after local storage drops
cases.intended_cause: The function returns a reference to a local Vec.
cases.principled_repair: Return ownership or borrow caller-owned storage.
cases.weak_repair: Leak every buffer.

cases.target_rule: a buffer cannot be mutated while a shared view remains in use
cases.intended_cause: Push requires mutable access while view is live.
cases.principled_repair: Finish using the view before mutation or separate storage.
cases.weak_repair: Use raw pointers.

cases.target_rule: a tiny view can retain a large owner
cases.intended_cause: The owner remains live while the view is used.
cases.principled_repair: Include backing storage in retention analysis.
cases.weak_repair: Report only the view length.

cases.target_rule: shared handles can retain an oversized frame for a tiny need
cases.intended_cause: The code compiles but the lifetime topology may be wasteful.
cases.principled_repair: Copy compact durable data when retention dominates.
cases.weak_repair: Advertise the design as zero copy.

cases.target_rule: queue capacity has a memory consequence
cases.intended_cause: The product of items and bytes is checked.
cases.principled_repair: Budget both item and byte capacity.
cases.weak_repair: Tune only queue length.

cases.target_rule: batching can have item and byte limits
cases.intended_cause: Either bound triggers a flush.
cases.principled_repair: Add a time/age bound in async systems.
cases.weak_repair: Wait until item count is full.

cases.target_rule: utilization requires a nonzero named capacity
cases.intended_cause: The zero-capacity case is explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Name the resource and observation window.
cases.weak_repair: Present total CPU percentage as handler utilization.

cases.target_rule: capacity headroom arithmetic can be explicit
cases.intended_cause: The calculation rejects invalid subtraction or overflow.
cases.principled_repair: Treat the result as an initial policy, not a universal constant.
cases.weak_repair: Set production at the measured saturation point.

cases.target_rule: shared mutable state across threads requires synchronization
cases.intended_cause: RefCell is not Sync and Arc does not add it.
cases.principled_repair: Use Mutex, atomics, or ownership transfer.
cases.weak_repair: Assert Sync unsafely.

cases.target_rule: queue depth cannot be represented by a negative integer
cases.intended_cause: The signed value cannot initialize usize.
cases.principled_repair: Validate and convert external metrics explicitly.
cases.weak_repair: Cast negative values with as.

cases.target_rule: load accounting reconciles offered work
cases.intended_cause: Every offered item is accounted for.
cases.principled_repair: Add completed, failed, and cancelled terminal states.
cases.weak_repair: Report completed throughput only.

cases.target_rule: an unbounded queue is valid Rust but weak production design
cases.intended_cause: The compiler cannot infer memory or latency budgets.
cases.principled_repair: Use bounded admission and typed rejection.
cases.weak_repair: Increase host memory.

cases.target_rule: metric labels can be a bounded enum
cases.intended_cause: Only a finite label set is representable.
cases.principled_repair: Keep arbitrary identity out of metrics.
cases.weak_repair: Use error text as a label.

cases.target_rule: structured fields are a stable schema
cases.intended_cause: Field names and values are explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Version or document public diagnostic schemas.
cases.weak_repair: Encode every fact in one message string.

cases.target_rule: secret-bearing types can prevent accidental Debug disclosure
cases.intended_cause: Debug output is explicitly redacted.
cases.principled_repair: Also control Display, serialization, and event fields.
cases.weak_repair: Rely on reviewers to notice secrets.

cases.target_rule: histogram buckets can be bounded and documented
cases.intended_cause: The output label set is finite.
cases.principled_repair: Use units in metric names or metadata.
cases.weak_repair: Create one label per exact latency.

cases.target_rule: diagnostic fields cannot borrow destroyed local storage
cases.intended_cause: The returned field points to a local String.
cases.principled_repair: Own the event field or borrow valid context.
cases.weak_repair: Leak diagnostic strings.

cases.target_rule: metric label values need one coherent type
cases.intended_cause: An integer cannot inhabit a &str array.
cases.principled_repair: Encode bounded outcomes through an enum or typed conversion.
cases.weak_repair: Format arbitrary values into labels.

cases.target_rule: structured context can omit payload data
cases.intended_cause: The runtime assertion checks the selected fields.
cases.principled_repair: Add explicit redaction tests.
cases.weak_repair: Log the whole request with Debug.

cases.target_rule: high-cardinality metric labels compile but can exhaust telemetry systems
cases.intended_cause: Every request creates a distinct series.
cases.principled_repair: Keep request identity in traces and use bounded metric dimensions.
cases.weak_repair: Increase metric backend capacity.

cases.target_rule: retries share one remaining deadline budget
cases.intended_cause: Elapsed time is subtracted with checked arithmetic.
cases.principled_repair: Stop when no budget remains.
cases.weak_repair: Reset the full timeout per attempt.

cases.target_rule: retry classification can be explicit
cases.intended_cause: Only the transient class retries.
cases.principled_repair: Combine classification with idempotency and limits.
cases.weak_repair: Retry every error.

cases.target_rule: error-budget consumption names its denominator
cases.intended_cause: Zero budget is handled explicitly.
cases.principled_repair: Define the population and window.
cases.weak_repair: Use raw error count as availability.

cases.target_rule: degradation can be an explicit state
cases.intended_cause: The mode is visible in the type.
cases.principled_repair: Define preserved semantics and recovery.
cases.weak_repair: Silently truncate output.

cases.target_rule: failure classification must be exhaustive
cases.intended_cause: The match omits other string values.
cases.principled_repair: Add a deliberate default or typed enum.
cases.weak_repair: Assume dependencies never add codes.

cases.target_rule: retry attempt bounds must fit their representation
cases.intended_cause: The literal exceeds u8.
cases.principled_repair: Choose a validated realistic bound.
cases.weak_repair: Use a larger type and allow hundreds of attempts.

cases.target_rule: retry amplification is measurable offered work
cases.intended_cause: The runtime calculation includes retries.
cases.principled_repair: Report attempts and semantic operations separately.
cases.weak_repair: Hide retries in dependency metrics.

cases.target_rule: an unbounded retry loop is type-correct
cases.intended_cause: The compiler cannot enforce deadline or attempt policy.
cases.principled_repair: Use one deadline, capped attempts, and backoff.
cases.weak_repair: Rely on eventual dependency recovery.

cases.target_rule: sensitive wrappers can restrict debug disclosure
cases.intended_cause: Debug does not expose the inner string.
cases.principled_repair: Audit all output paths and scope.
cases.weak_repair: Derive Debug on credential structures.

cases.target_rule: identifier policy can be enforced before privileged use
cases.intended_cause: The accepted character set is explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Also enforce authorization and length.
cases.weak_repair: Treat syntax validation as authorization.

cases.target_rule: untrusted sizes are checked before allocation
cases.intended_cause: The limit precedes use of the length.
cases.principled_repair: Apply byte, item, recursion, and time bounds.
cases.weak_repair: Allocate first and validate later.

cases.target_rule: authorization is a separate decision from parsing
cases.intended_cause: A typed capability drives the privileged operation.
cases.principled_repair: Bind identity and resource policy explicitly.
cases.weak_repair: Infer authority from a valid resource name.

cases.target_rule: a borrowed secret cannot outlive a temporary owner
cases.intended_cause: The temporary String drops at the statement end.
cases.principled_repair: Own the secret in a bounded wrapper.
cases.weak_repair: Leak it for static access.

cases.target_rule: unsized fields cannot appear directly except in the final position behind an appropriate indirection
cases.intended_cause: The struct attempts to contain `str` by value without a sized representation.
cases.principled_repair: Use String, Box<str>, or a validated secret wrapper.
cases.weak_repair: Hide the issue with an unrelated marker type.

cases.target_rule: resource exhaustion cases can be represented deterministically
cases.intended_cause: The runtime assertion establishes the hostile boundary.
cases.principled_repair: Reject before allocation.
cases.weak_repair: Allocate to see whether the host survives.

cases.target_rule: derived Debug can disclose credentials
cases.intended_cause: The program compiles and prints the token.
cases.principled_repair: Implement redacted formatting and test outputs.
cases.weak_repair: Avoid logging only by convention.

cases.target_rule: release metadata can be deterministically ordered
cases.intended_cause: BTreeMap iteration has key order.
cases.principled_repair: Define the manifest schema explicitly.
cases.weak_repair: Serialize a HashMap and hope order is stable.

cases.target_rule: artifact digest text can be validated structurally
cases.intended_cause: Length and character set are checked.
cases.principled_repair: Compute and verify the actual digest in release tooling.
cases.weak_repair: Trust a user-supplied digest.

cases.target_rule: supported release products can be finite typed combinations
cases.intended_cause: The target/profile pair is explicit.
cases.principled_repair: Add supported feature sets.
cases.weak_repair: Publish every theoretical combination.

cases.target_rule: artifact-size comparison can preserve signed direction
cases.intended_cause: The calculation avoids unsigned underflow.
cases.principled_repair: Report absolute and relative change.
cases.weak_repair: Use wrapping subtraction.

cases.target_rule: release metadata cannot borrow a destroyed temporary
cases.intended_cause: The String temporary drops before the static reference.
cases.principled_repair: Own runtime metadata or use a true static literal.
cases.weak_repair: Leak generated strings.

cases.target_rule: artifact fields need stable schema types
cases.intended_cause: A numeric size cannot initialize String.
cases.principled_repair: Format only at the manifest boundary.
cases.weak_repair: Store every field as unvalidated text.

cases.target_rule: deterministic metadata can exclude time and local paths
cases.intended_cause: The runtime assertions test two nondeterministic fields.
cases.principled_repair: Also compare complete artifacts in controlled builds.
cases.weak_repair: Call metadata reproducible without byte comparison.

cases.target_rule: wall-clock metadata makes otherwise identical artifacts differ
cases.intended_cause: The compiler accepts intentional nondeterminism.
cases.principled_repair: Store release time outside byte-reproducible artifacts.
cases.weak_repair: Ignore byte differences.

cases.target_rule: capacity models use checked arithmetic
cases.intended_cause: All products and sums can fail explicitly.
cases.principled_repair: Add measured headroom and target assumptions.
cases.weak_repair: Use averages without overflow checks.

cases.target_rule: readiness can distinguish full deployment from canary
cases.intended_cause: The state is more precise than one boolean.
cases.principled_repair: Include security, capacity, and observability evidence.
cases.weak_repair: Deploy whenever tests pass.

cases.target_rule: headroom must not silently underflow
cases.intended_cause: Over-planning produces None.
cases.principled_repair: State capacity source and workload.
cases.weak_repair: Cast a negative result to unsigned.

cases.target_rule: rollout stages can be explicit transitions
cases.intended_cause: Full promotion has no automatic next stage.
cases.principled_repair: Attach measurable promotion criteria.
cases.weak_repair: Use elapsed time alone.

cases.target_rule: runbook ownership cannot borrow transient local data in an API
cases.intended_cause: The returned reference outlives local storage.
cases.principled_repair: Own operational metadata or borrow caller storage.
cases.weak_repair: Leak process-lifetime strings.

cases.target_rule: rollout state handling must be exhaustive
cases.intended_cause: The Full variant is not handled.
cases.principled_repair: Model terminal and rollback transitions explicitly.
cases.weak_repair: Add a wildcard that silently promotes.

cases.target_rule: capacity planning can include deployment overlap
cases.intended_cause: The assertion checks the combined demand.
cases.principled_repair: Include failover and measurement error too.
cases.weak_repair: Plan from steady-state average only.

cases.target_rule: passing tests alone is not a production-readiness decision
cases.intended_cause: The compiler cannot require capacity, security, rollback, or observability.
cases.principled_repair: Use a complete readiness review and staged rollout.
cases.weak_repair: Treat deployment as the next test.
